jurisdictionQuote: City Charter of the City of Stuart, Florida

whatItDoes: Shall the City Charter of the City of Stuart, Florida be amended to add the following provision: The City Commission shall not sell, convey or lease for more than 1 year including any renewal options, any City-owned real property containing recreational ballﬁelds unless ﬁrst approved by the voters through a public referendum held under Charter Section 9.04 procedures for vacating public streets or abandoning right-of-way.
yesMeans: Shall the City Charter of the City of Stuart, Florida be amended to add the following provision: The City Commission shall not sell, convey or lease for more than 1 year including any renewal options, any City-owned real property containing recreational ballﬁelds unless ﬁrst approved by the voters through a public referendum held under Charter Section 9.04 procedures for vacating public streets or abandoning right-of-way.
noMeans: Shall the City Charter of the City of Stuart, Florida be amended to add the following provision: The City Commission shall not sell, convey or lease for more than 1 year including any renewal options, any City-owned real property containing recreational ballﬁelds unless ﬁrst approved by the voters through a public referendum held under Charter Section 9.04 procedures for vacating public streets or abandoning right-of-way.

reviewNote: Only city-owned property containing recreational ballfields is covered. Leases count renewal options toward the more-than-one-year threshold. Section9.04 procedure retained; no broader park/short-lease prohibition inferred.
